αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic αὐτοῦ): ’him’, after πάροιθε ’before him’ · also masc. gen. sg., object of τιτύσκετο: ’at him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖον: αὖος — dry; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’with a dry (hollow) ring’
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.

βαρέα: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; adj., neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily’
βιβάντα: βίβημι (βιβάω) — stride, step; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., with μακρά: ’striding with long steps’

γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαμβρὸς: γαμβρός — son-in-law, relative by marriage; masc. nom. sg.
γαστέρι: γαστήρ — belly, womb; fem. dat. sg., epic γαστέρι (= Attic γαστρί)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαφυρὰς: γλαφυρός — hollow, well-hollowed; fem. acc. pl., standing epithet of ships (νῆας γλαφυράς)
γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb of motion: ’(my) knees’ (γούνατα ὀρώρῃ)

δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίφρου: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. gen. sg., of separation after verbs of throwing out and stepping down: ’from the chariot’ · also a seat, stool · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἐπιβαίνω: ’mounted the chariot’ (δίφρου ἐπεβήσετο)
δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.

δαναοῖσι: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δηΐφοβος: Δηΐφοβος — Deiphobus, a son of Priam, a leading Trojan warrior; masc. nom. sg.
δηΐων: δήϊος — hostile; as noun, an enemy; masc. gen. pl., epic δηΐων (= Attic δηίων)
διοτρεφέος: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’) · also adv. ’right through’ before πρό (διὰ πρό)
δουρί: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δόρατι)
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δούπησεν: δουπέω — fall with a thud, thud; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδούπησε): ’thudded down’
δρῦς: δρῦς — oak; fem. acc. pl. (acc. pl. with long ῡ)
δωσέμεναι: δίδωμι — give; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic δώσειν): ’to give’
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk; spear (a shaft of wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. (gen. δουρός)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)

εἰληλούθει: ἔρχομαι — come, go; plpf. 3 sg. (perfect stem εἰληλουθ-, epic for Attic ἐληλύθει): ’had come’
εἰμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic εἰμέν (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’form, good looks’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
εἶθαρ: εἶθαρ — at once, straightway; adv., epic (= Attic εὐθύς)

εὐξαμένοιο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic εὐξαμένου), after ἔκλυες: ’when I prayed’
εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
εὔχεαι: εὔχομαι — claim, profess, boast; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὔχῃ)
ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
θέων: θέω — run, speed; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’running’
θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
θυγατρῶν: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. gen. pl., partitive after ἀρίστη: ’best of the daughters’
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θώρηξ: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. nom. sg., epic θώρηξ (= Attic θώραξ)

καλύψαι: καλύπτω — cover, hide, bury; aor. inf. act.: ’to cover’

κατένευσε: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant by a nod; aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound (κατ-έ-νευσε): ’nodded assent’

κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
κεῖτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκειτο): ’lay’, also with a neut. pl. subject (ἅρματα κεῖτο ’the chariots lay’)
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’fame, a good name’ (κλέος … ἄροιτο ’win fame’) · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after the fame’ (μετὰ κλέος ’in quest of the fame’)
κρατεροῖο: κρατερός — strong, mighty; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
κρατερὴν: κρατερός — strong, mighty, hard (by-form of καρτερός); fem. acc. sg.
κῆρι: κῆρ — heart; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic καρδίᾳ), in the idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περί an adverb) · also neut. dat. sg. alone, locative: ’in the heart’ (κῆρι φιλήσῃ ’love in his heart’)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λοιγὸν: λοιγός — ruin, destruction, havoc; masc. acc. sg.
λῆγε: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.: ’ceased’
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.

μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’

μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long (spear)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀχῆα: ’long’ (μακρὸν ὀχῆα ’the long bar’)
μεγάρῳ: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. sg.
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’
μετάλμενος: μεθάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at (μετά + ἅλλομαι); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (μετάλμενος): ’having leapt upon’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’)
μηκιστεὺς: Μηκιστεύς — Mecisteus, a Greek warrior, son of Echius; masc. nom. sg.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); ἦ μάν ’truly indeed’ · also ἄγρει μάν ’come then’ (with the interjection ἄγρει)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλγος: ’new’ (νέον ἔσσεται ἄλγος ’a new pain will be’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicate: ’young’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, agreeing with ἔργον: ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not at all new’)
νέστορος: Νέστωρ — Nestor, old king of Pylos; masc. gen. sg.
νήϊον: νήϊος — of a ship, for ships; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’ship-timber’
ναιόμενον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. pass. neut. acc. sg.: ’well-inhabited’
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νώροπι: νώροψ — flashing (traditional gloss; origin not known); masc. dat. sg., epithet of bronze, agreeing with χαλκῷ
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl. νῆες
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)

οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔρεσι: ὄρος (epic οὖρος) — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic οὔρεσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτασε: οὐτάω — wound (by a thrust), stab; aor. 3 sg. act.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα)
πάντοσ: πάντοσε — in every direction, on every side; adv., elided (πάντοσ’ = πάντοσε)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέδησε: πεδάω — bind, fetter, hold fast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπέδησε): ’bound’
πεζὸς: πεζός — on foot; adj., masc. nom. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περίβη: περιβαίνω — go round, stand over to guard; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augment dropped and accent thrown back (= περιέβη): ’strode about’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’)
πεσών: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
πιθήσας: πιθέω (epic aor. ἐπίθησα; cf. πείθομαι) — trust, obey (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’obeying’

ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεύξατο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray to, vow; vaunt over, boast; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’vaunted’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
ἐχίοιο: Ἐχίος — Echius, father of Mecisteus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑνὸς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου)
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔβαλ: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔβαλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck, hit’
ἔγχεος: ἔγχος — spear; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔγχους)
ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg.: of a tear, ’fell from’ (+ dat. of the person) · also ’fell out of’ + gen., of a broken blade (ἔκπεσε χειρός ’fell from the hand’) · also aor. 3 sg., of a man falling from a vehicle, + gen.: ’fell out of’ (ἔκπεσε δίφρου ’fell out of the chariot’)
ἔλασσεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἤλασε)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσχετο: ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; mid. hold before oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’held (before him)’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
ἕ: οὗ, οἷ, ἕ — he, she, it (3rd-person pron.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’him’
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
ἕπε: ἕπομαι — follow; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., elided, epic (ἕπε’ = ἕπεο; Attic ἕπου): ’follow!’
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question · also ἠέ, ’or’, introducing a further alternative in a list (ἠέ ποθι ’or somewhere’) · also ἠέ, ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠέ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’) · also ἠέ, ’than’, after a verb of wishing, with no comparative: ’rather than’ (δοῦναι κράτος ἠέ περ ἡμῖν ’to give strength rather than to us’) · also ἠέ … ἠέ, correlative ’either … or’, in a statement · also ἠέ … ἦέ, ’either … or’ (’whether … or’), in a direct double question (ἠέ τι βέβληαι … ἦέ τευ ἀγγελίης ’have you been hit … or have you come with news’)
ἠλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= ἠλεύσατο, σ dropped): ’avoided’
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came, passed’
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, + acc.: ’warded off’
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἥρω: ἥρως — hero; masc. acc. sg., elided ἥρω’ (= ἥρωα)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. voc. sg., a courteous address: ’hero!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’came, went’
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
ἱππασίδην: Ἱππασίδης — son of Hippasus (Charops); masc. acc. sg., patronymic
ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also after ὄφρα: ’that you may see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after αἴ κεν: ’if he should see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’ · also Ἴδη — Mount Ida, near Troy; fem. dat. sg., place where, after ἐν
ἵετο: ἵεμαι — hasten, be eager (+ dat./inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid. (middle of ἵημι ’send’)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
ὁμηλικίην: ὁμηλικίη — age-mates, company of the same age; fem. acc. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄβριμος: ὄβριμος — mighty, stout, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares · also epithet of Hector: ’mighty’
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ὑποδύντε: ὑποδύω — go under, get under; aor. part. act. dual masc. nom.: ’the two getting under’
ὑποσχόμενοι: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, undertake; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’promising’
ὑπό: ὑπό — under, beneath; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑπό … ἔλλαβε ’seized from beneath’); accented before the enclitic τε
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
ὑσμίνην: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg.
ὑψήνορα: Ὑψήνωρ — Hypsenor, son of Dolopion; masc. acc. sg.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’roused’
ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic ᾔτει)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥινοῖσι: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ῥῆξεν: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
